entities.summary: Bryce Lee Brown is an American former professional football player who was a running back for the Philadelphia Eagles, Buffalo Bills, and Seattle Seahawks of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Tennessee Volunteers as a freshman before transferring to the Kansas State Wildcats after head coach Lane Kiffin left Tennessee for USC. Later that year, Volunteers coach Derek Dooley declined to release Brown from his scholarship, resulting in Brown sitting out the 2010 season at Kansas State due to NCAA transfer rules.
